name: Restriction
look: Restriction barrier, a seal of layered runes from cultivation fantasy. Three stacked horizontal rings of glowing violet-white rune characters circle the character at knee, waist and head height, turning in alternating directions, joined by faint vertical light.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the three rune rings stacked as they stand, no glow, no light between them

parts.name: RING
parts.text: one rune ring alone, seen a little from above
forms: whole, seen a little from above
only half drawn, an arc being written
unravelling, runes peeling off one end

parts.name: GLYPH
parts.text: three single rune characters alone, large, side by side

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: violet sparks, a broken glyph, a vertical light streak

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the rings and the light joining them, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: the rings draw themselves one by one from the ground up, each rune lighting as it is written
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the three rings turn against each other and their runes pulse in sequence; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes from the right; the runes of the struck ring flare bright white along its length and the ring jolts, a burst of rune sparks at the impact point

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the rings unravel layer by layer from the top, their runes peeling away and fading
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels

rules: Exactly three rings in every frame once they are drawn, never four: one at knee height, one at waist height, one at head height, with an empty gap between each pair as tall as a ring, as in MAIN.
